title: Automation
summary: AUTOM'ATION, noun [Gr. self. The Greek plural, automata, is sometimes used; but the regular English plural, automatons, is preferable.] A self-moving machine, or one which moves by invisible springs.

inlines.v: AUTOM'ATION, noun [Gr. self. The Greek plural, automata, is sometimes used; but the regular English plural, automatons, is preferable.] A self-moving machine, or one which moves by invisible springs.
